statement: INSERT INTO workspace.mlpab7c22cd.churntraining605fb7 WITH tx AS (SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) event_time, CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) amount, CAST(balance AS DOUBLE) balance FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/transactions.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true) UNION ALL SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT), CAST(amount AS DOUBLE), CAST(balance AS DOUBLE) FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/transactions_late.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)), prof AS (SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) event_time, CAST(credit_score AS INT) credit_score, CAST(tier AS STRING) tier FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/profiles.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)), act AS (SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) event_time, CAST(sessions_7d AS INT) sessions_7d FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/activity.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)), hlth AS (SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) event_time, CAST(health_score AS DOUBLE) health_score FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/account_health.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)), lbl AS (SELECT account_id, CAST(label_time AS BIGINT) label_time, CAST(churned AS INT) churned FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab7c22cd/ingest/labels.csv', format=>'csv', header=>true)), tx_asof AS (SELECT account_id, label_time, amount, balance FROM (SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, t.amount, t.balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY t.event_time DESC) rn FROM lbl l JOIN tx t ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.event_time <= l.label_time) WHERE rn = 1), prof_asof AS (SELECT account_id, label_time, credit_score, tier FROM (SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, p.credit_score, p.tier, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY p.event_time DESC) rn FROM lbl l JOIN prof p ON p.account_id = l.account_id AND p.event_time <= l.label_time) WHERE rn = 1), act_asof AS (SELECT account_id, label_time, sessions_7d FROM (SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, a.sessions_7d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY a.event_time DESC) rn FROM lbl l JOIN act a ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND a.event_time <= l.label_time) WHERE rn = 1), hlth_asof AS (SELECT account_id, label_time, health_score FROM (SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, h.health_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY h.event_time DESC) rn FROM lbl l JOIN hlth h ON h.account_id = l.account_id AND h.event_time <= l.label_time) WHERE rn = 1) SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, tx_asof.amount, tx_asof.balance, prof_asof.credit_score, prof_asof.tier, act_asof.sessions_7d, hlth_asof.health_score, l.churned FROM lbl l LEFT JOIN tx_asof ON tx_asof.account_id = l.account_id AND tx_asof.label_time = l.label_time LEFT JOIN prof_asof ON prof_asof.account_id = l.account_id AND prof_asof.label_time = l.label_time LEFT JOIN act_asof ON act_asof.account_id = l.account_id AND act_asof.label_time = l.label_time LEFT JOIN hlth_asof ON hlth_asof.account_id = l.account_id AND hlth_asof.label_time = l.label_time
